_metadata.description: Tamil Nadu: 39 Lok Sabha (MP) constituencies, 234 Assembly (MLA) constituencies
_metadata.note: Pincode-to-constituency mapping for major urban pincodes is provided in 'pincode_map'. Full coverage requires a voter-roll-level geocoding database not publicly available in bulk.

_lok_sabha_note: Tamil Nadu returns 39 MPs to Lok Sabha. The 39 constituencies as of 2024 elections: Thiruvallur, Chennai North, Chennai Central, Chennai South, Sriperumbudur, Kancheepuram, Arakkonam, Vellore, Tiruvannamalai, Arani, Tiruppattur, Ranipet (bifurcated from Vellore in 2020 district, but no separate LS seat yet), Krishnagiri, Dharmapuri, Kallakurichi, Salem, Namakkal, Erode, Tiruppur, Nilgiris, Coimbatore, Pollachi, Dindigul, Karur, Tiruchirappalli, Perambalur, Cuddalore, Chidambaram, Mayiladuthurai, Nagapattinam, Thanjavur, Sivaganga, Madurai, Theni, Virudhunagar, Ramanathapuram, Tenkasi, Tirunelveli, Thoothukkudi, Kanniyakumari. Assembly segment assignments per ECI Delimitation Order 2008.

pincode_map._note: Pincode-to-constituency mapping. One pincode may span multiple wards/areas. Assignments based on primary/majority area per ECI voter roll data and postal records.
